snippet.title: Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edtion Trailer
snippet.description:
Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edition

Official website: www.geopolitical-simulator-5.com

The latest expansion of the ultra-realistic world simulator, where you play as the head of state or the opposition! Main New Features: tourism simulator, party strategies with regime censures, personal wealth management, a European army, AI and Robotics.

Simulations 2026 and 2025
The game offers the possibility to start the campaign at the beginning of 2026 or 2025.
Both historical contexts are recreated with updated corresponding economic data, the annual events calendar. Governments and parliaments are accurately reproduced for both periods, with their political orientation and the composition of their ministerial team.

War in Europe

On the European continent, the Russian threat is spreading. After a U.S. disengagement from NATO, play as one or several European countries to stop the Kremlin’s war machine. You will need to strengthen national defenses, share a nuclear umbrella, or even create a true European army. As the head of this coalition, you will command all units to prevent Russia from conquering further territories.

Tourism Simulation

Develop your national tourism industry to climb the global tourism rankings, win the title of the most visited city in the world, or have new sites recognized as UNESCO World Heritage.
Highly detailed with numerous real-world data, the simulation measures tourism appeal based on many criteria (natural and cultural assets, international events, cost of living, coastal, leisure, or mountain infrastructure, accommodation options, quality of transportation, public safety, road safety, terrorist risk, climate, gastronomy, disaster risk, health safety, human rights…), which you can influence and develop as the leader of a country or as the head of major companies in the sector, by building on the map, subsidizing, budgeting, or leveraging influence.

Regime Censorship and New Political Party Strategies

Various systems of censure practiced in the world are reproduced here: motion against the head of state and/or their government, vote by simple or absolute majority, dissolution of Parliament, vote of confidence on a legislative bill. As the head of state, the player must face these attacks led by the opposing party AI. Conversely, as the head of the opposition party, the player can attempt to bring down the regime to trigger new elections or take their place. Political influence and communication, the formation (or destruction) of political coalitions, are essential to emerge as the winner in these situations.
New settings for parties have been added, which determine the level of activity of parties managed by the AI.

Management of Personal Wealth
 As a politician or businessman, players can grow their fortune. Various options are available: increase wealth, buy and sell valuable items (cars, private jets, paintings, yachts, diamonds...), build luxurious properties, stock market speculation… 
The ranking of the wealthy is constantly updated, and a scenario is devoted to the champions of the "bling".

AI and Robotics Development

The game simulates the evolution of artificial intelligence and robotics and their consequences on society, particularly regarding employment. These disruptions open the door to new policies you can attempt to implement: technological transition of the state and civil service, taxation of new technologies to offset job losses and redistribute economic gains fairly, or even the establishment of a universal income.

Many other new features and improvements

    • Increase in game speed: the passage of time has been accelerated  (more than 100% for the passage of a year compared to 2024 version), more realistic speed for units moving on the map with a dynamic adaptation of military units over long distances (missiles, aircraft, ships…)

    •  Economic Attractiveness: foreign companies expanding into national territory increases employment and raises the GDP, tax and social revenues. Various tools are available to the player to mix it up: advantageous taxation, public services, infrastructures, innovations or even subsidies.

    • Management of Military Coalitions: if the player wishes, there is the possibility of directing all armies of the coalition of countries that their nation belongs to. They can also change the way unit banners are displayed on the military map.

    • Nuclear Umbrella: this is the guarantee that a country possessing atomic weapons will defend a non-nuclear country.

    • US Supreme Court: they have a role in the American legislative process. Justices can strike down legislation that goes against the US Constitution. The player as head of state can try to influence them.

    • Worldwide Laws: as a member of the G20, the player can propose new legislation applicable to every country of the world. Extensive lobbying will be required to achieve these goals.
